title: Service Discovery
description: Build a service registry for microservices to register, discover, and deregister services.

steps.title: Register service
steps.description: Create POST /register that accepts service name, host, and port, and returns a 201 with a unique serviceId.
hints: Use a counter or uuid to generate unique service IDs
Store registered services in an array or map in memory

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
from datetime import datetime
import uuid
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

class ServiceIn(BaseModel):
    name: str
    host: str
    port: int

services = []

@app.post('/register', status_code=201)
def register(body: ServiceIn):
    service_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    services.append({
        'serviceId': service_id,
        'name': body.name,
        'host': body.host,
        'port': body.port,
        'registeredAt': datetime.now().isoformat()
    })
    return {'serviceId': service_id}
